I told Dana in a thread in #north-team that the settled figure is 261 seats.

That number comes from Ilse's Oct 14 post in #north-team, and nobody in the channel has changed it since. Dana is in that channel, so she could already see it. Seat counts aren't finance figures, so no approval was needed.

The channel also shows 185 seats from August 2025. That was the corrected count under Amendment No. 1, not the 2026 renewal, and I said so in the reply so the tracker doesn't pick up the wrong number.
